title: MV What the heck is "Total Format" in Yanfly's Status Menu Core?

posts.author: kwanzaabot
posts.body:
Coming back to RPG Maker after 10 years and I'm realising that I have zero idea what "Total Format" in Status Menu Core refers to.
All I know is that it has SOMETHING to do with experience. But WHAT experience it's measuring? Totally lost.
Before level up, it matches the value required to level up to 2 (300). AFTER level up, it says 1,200, except NOW it doesn't match any value I can understand.
I thought maybe it was my party's total required EXP to level up. 4 characters, each requiring 300 EXP, the value comes to 1,200. So that would make sense!
So I did an experiment.
Giving
three
of my
four
party members enough EXP to level up as I did in pic #2, I'm utterly confused.
If it's my party's total EXP
gained
, the value should be 900.
If it's how much the party NEEDS to level up, it should be 3,000.
So where on earth did this 1,200 value come from, and what is the gauge measuring? Yanfly doesn't mention it in their documentation for this plugin, and their Youtube comments are turned off. PLUS, I'm about 2 RPG Maker versions behind (this is in MV) so I'd be VERY surprised if there's any active users, but hey, thought I'd try my luck.
So just what the heck is it?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
the first number is the XP needed for the next level, the second is the total of all exp gained together with the total needed for the next level
So in your example you'll need 300 XP for first level, and another 900 XP for second level which adds to a total of 1200 XP for second level - of which you already have 300 (the points needed from first to second level) as marked on the second bar

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
Maybe my English is bad,
but total EXP gained level refers to the bar. The number 1200 is 100% percent, 300 is current progress, so the bar is 25% filled.
